purpose: Turn verified delivery, journey and exception signals into explainable customer-service workload and service-recovery intelligence.
rules: A case may be created only from a verified operational signal or an authenticated customer request.
A single unverified signal must not create an escalation.
Verified delivery-window breach may create ACTION_REQUIRED.
Verified security or cargo exception may create ESCALATED and must preserve operational safety priority.
Missing live feed must be represented as UNAVAILABLE rather than estimated.
Customer commitments require authorized human confirmation.
No invented ETA, location, delivery status, customer sentiment or resolution claim.
